item: The QID label resolver names a refused redirect, a missing transport and the kill switch as their own reasons, and the Ollama installer's release lookup refuses a redirect off api.github.com
key_paths: src/catalog/qid_labels.py; src/api/source_management.py; src/llm/installer.py; src/api/llm.py; tests/test_qid_label_resolution.py; tests/test_session_host_list.py; docs/SECURITY.md; docs/ledger/OPEN_QUEUE.md
summary: Follow-up to #1394. The QID label resolver declined every failed lookup as label_not_resolved; it now declines a RedirectRefused as redirect_refused (counted as lookups_refused, with the class name and no address), a TransportUnavailable as transport_unavailable (the row and the rest of the run), and a lookup the kill switch refused as network_refused (the check now runs after the polite sleep; the rows to decline come from the de-duplicated order). admit_or_decline carries each row's reason with its own detail text. The installer's api.github.com release lookup now names GITHUB_API_HOSTS (pinned equal to the endpoint host); a redirect off it raises InstallerRedirectRefused (a verification error, so the route answers 502) with a fixed sentence that names no host, raised outside the except block with no cause or context, class name only in the log. The asset download stays unlisted on purpose; SECURITY.md says why, UNLISTED_SESSIONS pins it and a STILL OPEN queue entry records what closing it takes. One independent read (0 block, 2 should-fix, 10 low) folded; mutants killed.
